name: MAD Club
hero_title: We build apps. Then we build the people who build them.
hero_lead: A student club at New Horizon College of Engineering. Small teams, real projects, workshops and hackathons on Android, Flutter and modern mobile development.

stats.label: flagship events run end to end

highlights.title: Informative workshops
highlights.text: Hands-on sessions built for practical takeaways.

highlights.title: App development
highlights.text: Learn the tools and techniques for building real apps.

why_lead: We promote learning and creating modern mobile apps through small teams working on real projects.

why.title: Skill building
why.text: Programming, design and problem-solving through practice.

cta_text: Hackathons, design sprints and a community that ships.

about.who: A student group that promotes learning and building modern mobile apps. Members work in small teams on practical projects through workshops, hackathons and design challenges each semester.
about.objective: Strengthen mobile programming skills, give students a way to see their ideas become real, and build a community around creativity, teamwork, entrepreneurship and learning.
about.outcomes: Better programming and creative skills, familiarity with current tools, and teamwork skills for professional settings.

functions.title: Flagship events
functions.text: Coding challenges, UI design sprints and pitch competitions (Mindspark, InnoWave, TechSync), open to all students.

functions.title: Hands-on workshops
functions.text: The full app process, from idea and design to a working build.

functions.title: Four committees
functions.text: Program, Project, Marketing and Review keep everything running.
